title: Hu Taong
tagline: Pong, the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor way.
description: A Hu Tao themed take on Pong. Play a friend on one keyboard (Red: W A S D, Blue: arrow keys) or face the AI on five difficulties from Baby to Insane, with adaptive AI, chaos mode, endless mode and win-by-two rules. Over thirty backgrounds, mood-matched music and match stats.

versions.notes:
First release.
- Local two-player and vs AI (Baby, Easy, Normal, Hard, Insane), with adaptive AI
- Chaos mode, endless mode and win-by-two
- Background gallery, mood-based music, display/audio/gameplay settings and match stats

builds.note: Runs from source: needs Python 3 with pygame (pip install pygame).
